body: TOPIC-MODELING CONSEQUENCE: do not add a global topic projection or Topic identity in v0.1. Local topical cohesion/change may appear as a receipted feature track and boundary-evidence overlay; named themes or motifs appear as evidence-backed descriptor claims in the inspector; a corpus-level TopicBasis/TopicMixture becomes an optional sidecar only when a concrete cross-story query requires comparability. None of these may determine story identity, hierarchy, causality, or base Atlas geometry.
